status.main_product: Industrial, food, and pharmaceutical packaging films
status.scope_reason: Ergis S.A. manufactures and sells polymer-based films for pharmaceutical packaging as one of its primary product lines.
status.evidence: According to the official corporate website, Ergis S.A. is based in Warsaw and actively manufactures industrial, food, and pharmaceutical packaging films.

claims.claim: The company reports the manufacture of medical cover and curtain barrier films for patients and medical personnel available in a thickness of 0.1 mm, as shown on the official Ergis website.

The company reports that its specialized medical cover films, distributed to hospitals and health centers as protective barriers during the COVID-19 pandemic, are explicitly manufactured as non-sterile products according to its official customer catalog.
Ergis S.A. maintains active quality and product safety management certifications across its group facilities including ISO 9001 and the BRC Standard with AA status for food-contact packaging.

The company reports that its total Group revenue exceeded PLN 1147 million in 2022, which includes the manufacturing of films for packaging pharmaceuticals alongside food and industrial packaging products.
